summary: A while loop repeats as long as its condition is true. Use it when you do not know ahead of time how many times to repeat.
notes: The condition goes in parentheses: while (savings < 100).
The condition is checked before each pass through the loop.
When the condition is false at the start, the body runs zero times.
pitfall: Forgetting to change the variable in the condition makes an infinite loop. The program never stops.
